info.title: About
info.about: GBA ROMs (.gba · .zip) run on the mGBA core in the app's bin\core folder, and web builds (.wgba · .wasm) run on the built-in host or on the build's original page. No ROMs or official BIOS are included (mGBA's built-in HLE BIOS is used).
info.mgba: mGBA 0.10.1 — Copyright © 2013-2022 Jeffrey Pfau and contributors. Mozilla Public License 2.0. https://mgba.io
info.mgbaSource: Source: https://github.com/mgba-emu/mgba/tree/0.10.1 (bundled unmodified as a static library). Includes: blip_buf (LGPL-2.1), inih (BSD-3-Clause).
info.others: Tauri 2 · WRY · TAO (Apache-2.0 OR MIT), Microsoft Edge WebView2, windows-rs (MIT OR Apache-2.0), zip (MIT), Tabler Icons (MIT), pako (MIT AND Zlib).

cfg.title: Settings
cfg.saveTitle: Saves the General and Keys tabs
cfg.range: {group} · {label}: only whole numbers from {min} to {max} are allowed
cfg.group.save.note: Saves are written straight into a single <file name>.sav right next to the opened file (about a second after the game saves, and on close). No backup file is made.
cfg.scaleMode.note: Fit to area fills the right-hand area (keeping the 240:160 ratio); integer scale grows in whole steps such as 1×, 2×, 3×
cfg.railCollapsed.note: Hides the left toolbar and side panel to widen the game screen (Ctrl+B)
cfg.pauseWhenHidden: Pause when the window is hidden
cfg.pauseWhenHidden.note: Pauses the game when the window is minimized or loses focus, and resumes when you come back
cfg.muted.note: Silences the game. Same as the sound button on the toolbar
cfg.fastMute.note: When on, no sound plays while fast forwarding. When off, the sound plays sped up by the same factor
cfg.fastScale.note: Speed used when fast forward is toggled with Tab or while Space is held
cfg.dpadMode.note: By default only the last pressed direction is passed, so you turn as soon as you press. Passing all, like a real GBA, lets the game decide
cfg.slot.note: Slot used by the toolbar's save/load state buttons and the Game menu (1~9). F1~F9 use the slot with that number
cfg.wgbaLink.note: Double-clicking a .wgba or .wgbp in Explorer opens it in webGBA. Linked for this user only, without administrator rights
cfg.webRom: ROM file name for web builds
cfg.webRom.note: When opening a .wgba · .wasm, the ROM with this name in the same folder (or the folder above) is used. Leave empty to use the only .gba in the same folder; if there are several, you choose once and it is remembered per build. A .wgba with a packed ROM always uses its own ROM
cfg.favorites.note: {count} · clear all with the trash button
cfg.recent.note: {count} · clear all with the trash button
cfg.useDevelopKit.note: Enables the developer tools and the right-click menu. Applied after restarting webGBA
cfg.keys.title: Key layout
cfg.keys.note: Click a box, then press the key to use. Esc cancels and right-click clears. Gamepads use the standard layout automatically.
cfg.keys.slotTitle: Click, then press the key to use · right-click to clear
cfg.keys.resetTitle: Restores the default key layout (saved when you click SAVE)
cfg.lang.title: Display language
cfg.lang.note: Changes the text of the webGBA screens. Text inside games (ROM · wasm) does not change.
theme.randomTitle: Applies one of the presets at random
theme.shuffleTitle: Generates a new color set with the conditions chosen above
theme.resetTitle: Restores the colors of the Dark theme
theme.copyTitle: Copies this preset's colors into the custom theme so they can be edited
theme.customNote: Changes apply immediately. SHUFFLE generates about 70 colors at once from the conditions below — only combinations that pass a text/background contrast check are shown.
theme.presetNote: Preset colors cannot be edited. Use COPY to create a custom theme, then edit the colors below one by one.
theme.ratioLow: Below 4.5:1 — text is hard to read against the background
theme.ratioOk: Contrast between text and background (4.5:1 or more recommended)
theme.note.monokai: Warm charcoal with a teal accent
theme.note.dracula: Purple background with a pink accent
theme.note.forest: Deep forest background with a green accent
theme.note.contrast: White background with black text and accents
theme.tone.any.note: Either a light or a dark background
theme.tone.light.note: Dark text on a background as bright as white paper
theme.tone.dark.note: Light text on a dark background
theme.cast.any.note: Generates colors without a fixed hue
theme.cast.gray.note: A gray screen with no hue. Set the brightness to Light for a white theme
theme.cast.red.note: A screen with a reddish tint
theme.cast.orange.note: A screen with an orange tint
theme.cast.yellow.note: A screen with a yellowish tint
theme.cast.green.note: A screen with a green tint
theme.cast.teal.note: A screen with a teal tint
theme.cast.blue.note: A screen with a bluish tint
theme.cast.violet.note: A screen with a violet tint
theme.cast.pink.note: A screen with a pink tint
theme.group.lines.note: Named by use · darkness adjusted to each theme's background
